description: This file defines repositories and denormalizers for managing and transforming project analysis data in a database, including global and scoped denormalization operations related to commits, tech areas, and recent changes.

classes.name: GlobalDenormalizer
classes.description: Handles global denormalization processes, such as populating views for top committers and tech areas.

classes.name: ScopedDenormalizer
classes.description: Handles scoped denormalization tasks for specific targets, including recent views and changes over time.

methods.name: DenormalizeToTopCommitter
methods.description: Populates the denormalized view for top committers.

methods.name: DenormalizeToTopTechArea
methods.description: Populates the denormalized view for top tech areas.

methods.name: DenormalizeToRecentView
methods.description: Inserts analyzed diff rows into the recent project view.

methods.name: DenormalizeToChangesOverTime
methods.description: Inserts diff data representing changes over time into the database.

methods.name: DenormalizeToRecentCommits
methods.description: Inserts recent commit data into the database.

methods.name: deleteExistingView
methods.description: Deletes existing data from a specified denormalized view table.

methods.name: rowsWithScopedIndices
methods.description: Prepares rows with scoped indices for insertion.
